meta.title: Test Probe Of The Conjugated Future - 2

units.rawText: After an intense battle, we finally reach the Lab.
units.displayText: After an intense battle, we finally reach the Lab.

spans.text: After an intense battle, we finally reach the Lab.

units.rawText: The lab is in shambles after the Entropic attack.
units.displayText: The lab is in shambles after the Entropic attack.

spans.text: The lab is in shambles after the Entropic attack.

units.rawText: Shards of glass are strewn all over the ground; the furniture is wrecked, and there are cracks in the walls... Even Daru's beloved wives have not escaped this disaster. He would probably faint if he saw the state they are in now.

units.rawText: Still, it's just like Erika said; although the building is tinted purple, the damage to the interior is minimal and everything still seems operable.
units.displayText: Still, it's just like Erika said; although the building is tinted purple, the damage to the interior is minimal and everything still seems operable.

spans.text: Still, it's just like Erika said; although the building is tinted purple, the damage to the interior is minimal and everything still seems operable.

units.rawText: We'll guard the entrance. Go in and send that mail!
units.displayText: We'll guard the entrance. Go in and send that mail!

spans.text: We'll guard the entrance. Go in and send that mail!

units.rawText: Okarin, all the preparations are complete! Please help Kurisu-chan!
units.displayText: Okarin, all the preparations are complete! Please help Kurisu-chan!

spans.text: Okarin, all the preparations are complete! Please help Kurisu-chan!

units.rawText: It was the second dust explosion that caused Kurisu to die.
units.displayText: It was the second dust explosion that caused Kurisu to die.

spans.text: It was the second dust explosion that caused Kurisu to die.

units.rawText: While I don't know what caused it, if I can warn my past self about it, I'm sure I can prevent her death that way!
units.displayText: While I don't know what caused it, if I can warn my past self about it, I'm sure I can prevent her death that way!

spans.text: While I don't know what caused it, if I can warn my past self about it, I'm sure I can prevent her death that way!

units.rawText: I type "beware 2nd explosion protect Kurisu" into my phone, and as the PhoneWave (name subject to change) begins to arc with electricity, I mash the Send button.
